title: Fire safety audit of all elevated stations and compliance reporting

findings.text: The Operations Control Centre must complete the pending drills and report to the Chief Safety Officer not later than 31 August 2026.
findings.textEn: The Operations Control Centre must complete the pending drills and report to the Chief Safety Officer not later than 31 August 2026.
findings.quote: The Operations Control Centre must complete the pending drills and report to the Chief Safety Officer not later than 31 August 2026.

findings.text: Every Station Controller shall replace all expired portable extinguishers and certify the replacement to the Safety Department on or before 21 August 2026.
findings.textEn: Every Station Controller shall replace all expired portable extinguishers and certify the replacement to the Safety Department on or before 21 August 2026.
findings.quote: Every Station Controller shall replace all expired portable extinguishers and certify the replacement to the Safety Department on or before 21 August 2026.

findings.text: This circular sets out what each department must do and by when.
findings.textEn: This circular sets out what each department must do and by when.
findings.quote: This circular sets out what each department must do and by when.

findings.text: Non-compliance with this statutory reporting requirement attracts a penalty under the Metro Railways Act, and the audit findings will be reviewed by the Board.
findings.textEn: Non-compliance with this statutory reporting requirement attracts a penalty under the Metro Railways Act, and the audit findings will be reviewed by the Board.
findings.quote: Non-compliance with this statutory reporting requirement attracts a penalty under the Metro Railways Act, and the audit findings will be reviewed by the Board.

findings.text: The annual fire safety audit of the elevated corridor found expired portable extinguishers at eleven stations and two partially functional smoke detection loops.
findings.textEn: The annual fire safety audit of the elevated corridor found expired portable extinguishers at eleven stations and two partially functional smoke detection loops.
findings.quote: The annual fire safety audit of the elevated corridor found expired portable extinguishers at eleven stations and two partially functional smoke detection loops.

findings.text: Station staff were retrained on extinguisher handling in July, and attendance records are held by HumanResources for inspection.
findings.textEn: Station staff were retrained on extinguisher handling in July, and attendance records are held by HumanResources for inspection.
findings.quote: Station staff were retrained on extinguisher handling in July, and attendance records are held by HumanResources for inspection.

findings.text: The Signalling and Telecom department is responsible for restoring both faulty smoke detection loops.
findings.textEn: The Signalling and Telecom department is responsible for restoring both faulty smoke detection loops.
findings.quote: The Signalling and Telecom department is responsible for restoring both faulty smoke detection loops.

findings.text: Until restoration, a fire watch is required at the affected platforms during all service hours.
findings.textEn: Until restoration, a fire watch is required at the affected platforms during all service hours.
findings.quote: Until restoration, a fire watch is required at the affected platforms during all service hours.
